components.css: .ds-category-definitions{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden}.ds-categories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:1000px;margin:auto;gap:0;background:var(--ivory)}.ds-sculpted{display:block;position:relative;isolation:isolate;aspect-ratio:1.75;overflow:hidden;clip-path:url(#ds-category-watch-curve);background:#e7dfd2;color:var(--espresso);text-decoration:none}.ds-sculpted-copy{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);right:6%;width:34%}.ds-sculpted h3{font:400 clamp(30px,3.6vw,48px)/1.1 Editorial,Georgia,serif;margin:0}.ds-sculpted p{font:13px/1.5 Everyday,Arial,sans-serif;max-width:15ch;margin:8px 0 0}.ds-sculpted-arrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;margin-top:13px}.ds-sculpted-bag{clip-path:url(#ds-category-bag-curve);margin-top:-8%;color:var(--ivory);background:#e7dfd2}.ds-sculpted-bag .ds-sculpted-copy{left:8%;right:auto;top:50%;width:34%}.ds-sculpted:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:7px}.ds-category-reveal:has(.ds-sculpted:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:1000px){.ds-sculpted p{font-size:11px}}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-sculpted{aspect-ratio:1.75}.ds-sculpted-copy{right:7%;top:52%;width:33%}.ds-sculpted h3{font-size:30px}.ds-sculpted p{margin-top:7px}.ds-sculpted-arrow{margin-top:10px}.ds-sculpted-bag .ds-sculpted-copy{left:7%;top:48%;width:30%}}

narrative.overview: Minimal luxury with restrained feminine detail, warm paper surfaces, rose italics and straight-edged shopping photography. The homepage opens with a silent cinematic concept fashion film and a separate collection action below the footage. An independent watches-and-handbags prototype for Indian women discovering accessories on mobile.

rules.name: Legible rose
rules.body: Use deeper rose for italic text; dusty rose is decorative.

dos: Do label demo products, representative photography and illustrative prices.
Do preserve reduced motion, keyboard focus and mobile layouts.
Do keep the film unobstructed, with Explore Collection centred in a separate 52px minimum ivory strip below it.
Do preserve responsive still fallback, accessible playback control, offscreen and hidden pause, and preference-aware film source loading.
Do retain generated-concept provenance and fictional-accessory context in documentation, with no visible concept caption on the hero.
Do use the supplied transparent gold logo in header and footer with its original proportions.
donts: Don't invent reviews, discounts, popularity or fulfilment claims.
Don't connect production services or collect payment.
Don't restore the old text-heavy split hero, overlay a visible title on the model or add extra pink decoration.
Don't present concept-film accessories as actual inventory.
